About Me

I am Monzer Hisham, an 18-year-old student based in Giza, Egypt, currently in my final year of high school (Mathematics Track). My journey is defined by a balance between rigorous academics, technical creation, and community engagement.

Whether I am leading tech projects, organizing impactful events, or running digital platforms to guide my peers, I strive for continuous growth.

Beyond tech and leadership, I am a dedicated long-distance runner and functional fitness enthusiast, which has taught me resilience, discipline, and the power of consistent daily progress.
